Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_Enabled_tooltip: Use this mod's sight checks. Off leaves vanilla spotting in charge.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_DetectionThresho: Awareness needed before a zombie detects the player. Higher is harder to get spotted.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_BaseGainPerSecon: How fast awareness rises in clear view, before the other modifiers. Higher fills the meter faster.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_MaxEvaluationDel: Longest hitch, in seconds, that one check can count. Higher lets a stall add more awareness.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_DecayDelaySecond: How long awareness stays put after the player leaves view, in seconds.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_DecayPerSecond_t: How fast awareness falls after the delay. Higher means zombies forget sooner.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_ReacquireThresho: Awareness needed to detect again after the zombie has dropped its target. Higher makes a second detection harder.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_MinimumVisionRan: Shortest sight distance, in tiles. Keep this at or below maximum vision range, or detection turns off.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_MaximumVisionRan: Longest sight distance, in tiles. Keep this at or above minimum vision range, or detection turns off.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_CloseRange_toolt: Distance, in tiles, inside which facing no longer reduces awareness gain.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_MaximumFloorDiff: How many floors apart a zombie can still see the player.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_RearCutoffDot_to: Facing cutoff. 1 is straight ahead and -1 is straight behind. Higher narrows vision toward the front.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_PeripheralStreng: Scales awareness gain toward the edge of vision. Front gain stays the same. Higher makes side approaches easier to notice.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_MinimumLightFact: Lowest exposure multiplier in darkness. Higher keeps the player easier to notice in the dark.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_LightExponent_to: Shapes how target-square light affects exposure. Higher makes dim light count for less.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_StationaryFactor: Exposure multiplier while the player is still. Lower makes standing still quieter to notice.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_WalkingFactor_to: Exposure multiplier while the player is walking.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_RunningFactor_to: Exposure multiplier while the player is running. Higher makes sprinting easier to notice.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_SneakSkillStreng: How much Sneaking changes exposure. Higher makes the skill matter more.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_InconspicuousFac: Exposure multiplier for the Inconspicuous trait. Lower hides that trait more.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_ConspicuousFacto: Exposure multiplier for the Conspicuous trait. Higher makes that trait easier to notice.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_GoodSightFactor_: Sight-range multiplier for zombies with the good-sight lore. Higher lets them see farther.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_PoorSightFactor_: Sight-range multiplier for zombies with the poor-sight lore. Lower shortens their sight more.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_RainPenaltyStren: How many tiles of sight heavy rain removes. Higher shortens vision more in the rain.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_FogPenaltyStreng: How many tiles of sight heavy fog removes. Higher shortens vision more in fog.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_EatingVisionFact: Sight and exposure multiplier while the player is eating. Lower makes eating hide you more.
Sandbox_StealthOverhaul_RecordExpirySeco: How long an idle zombie-player awareness record is kept, in seconds.
